facts.statement: The genus Eoscyllium is considered valid.
Eoscyllium lived during the Jurassic period, specifically from the Toarcian to the Kimmeridgian ages.
Fossils of Eoscyllium have been found in Belgium, France, Germany, Luxembourg, and the United Kingdom.
facts.quote: Country: Belgium, France, Germany, Luxembourg, United Kingdom

facts.statement: Eoscyllium is interpreted as a carpet shark, probably belonging to the family Hemiscylliidae.
facts.quote: A carpet shark, probably a member of the family Hemiscylliidae.

facts.statement: The type species of Eoscyllium is the previously named "Heterodontus" duffini described by Thies in 1983.
facts.quote: The type species is "Heterodontus" duffini Thies (1983).

facts.statement: In the Paleobiology Database, Eoscyllium is listed as a genus authored by Delsate in 2026.
Eoscyllium is placed within the family Hemiscylliidae.
Eoscyllium belongs to the class Chondrichthyes.
The temporal range of Eoscyllium extends from the Toarcian to the Tithonian, about 182.9 to 145.06 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Toarcian to Tithonian (182.9 to 145.06 million years ago)

facts.statement: Twelve fossil occurrences of Eoscyllium have been recorded in the database.

rejected.statement: Eoscyllium is a newly established genus described by Delsate in 2026.
